Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 31
Reason for Mistake: The agent asked the user to extract county seat city populations from the Census “County Population Totals: 2020–2024” page, which only contains county-level data, not the required place-level 2020 Decennial counts. This misuse of the source entrenched a loop of manual requests and made it hard to pivot to the correct place-level queries on data.census.gov. As the first irrecoverable step, it directly caused the failure to obtain the needed figures and compute the difference.
